candidate_relations.mapping: Use the already combined learning-to-action question to frame a HOMESENSE proposition. Carry J39 and J40, their publication history and inherited J38/J41 links. A separate mapping records outcomes, confounders and revision conditions.
dependencies: Existing Jigsaw human decision remains the authority for J39/J40 only.
A named concept_id and an explicit proposition must be chosen before any mapping is populated.
Independent methods, ethics, consent and preregistration gates apply before a study.
candidate_relations.boundary: Navigation and protocol-design context only; no new piece, merge, outcome or efficacy finding.
candidate_relations.reject_if: A same-direction crosswalk is located, the question adds no decision value, or the mapping conflates a reflective question with an intervention.

candidate_relations.mapping: Use BQ011 outcome families as a menu for application mappings, paired with its alternative models and causal boundaries. Select and operationalise only relevant outcomes; do not require all seven or collapse levels. This can later inform the existing HOMESENSE809→858 care case.
dependencies: PR345 remains an open review candidate; no BQ011 canonical registration or maturity change.
Select validated measures, units, timing, burden and adverse outcomes for the actual question.
Use the existing template and care proposal, not another research axis or allocation engine.
candidate_relations.boundary: Methods vocabulary only. No evidence is transferred from BQ011 or from a published HOMESENSE proposal.
candidate_relations.reject_if: Outcome categories lack relevance or operational definitions, existing equivalent mappings are found, or a causal level is silently substituted.

candidate_relations.mapping: Manually map claim_id→claims[].id and wording→claims[].text. Resolve source_ids through the packet sources to refs. The source location is not an exact passage: verified extraction is a separate prerequisite. Scope population/conditions/definition/time and nominated pairs need explicit review. Preserve original packet, access states, lanes, alternatives, missing evidence, assessments and revision history in a companion; the triage tool is a reduced view.
dependencies: PR367 and PR402 remain separate unreleased drafts; no code is copied or schema loosened.
Block actual transfer when passages, scope or source identity are unavailable; unknown is not not-applicable.
M02, M03, M04, M07 and M12 are relevant; this mapping satisfies none of M01–M12.
candidate_relations.boundary: No executable adapter, source authentication, contradiction verdict, evidence ranking, reviewer attestation or release approval.
candidate_relations.reject_if: Mapping drops context silently, invents passages, coerces epistemic types, changes source access, or an existing reviewed adapter already covers this path.

matrix.title: OMNI claims → contradiction review

matrix.title: Source identity and correction lineage
matrix.verified_state: Main has crosspost lineage and a provenance contract. CUT plus its dated correction is already registered by OMNI and prepared as PILOT-A.
matrix.next_contribution: Reuse the source bundle and original post/comment IDs. Add only newly verified manifestations; no second CUT integration proposal.
matrix.evidence_boundary: Representations and dated corrections of one work are not independent corroboration.

matrix.title: Provenance blockers as intake filters
matrix.verified_state: N2N indexes mix review depths; PR377 records blocked repository-only reviews. PR379 already has a blocked-admission crosswalk.
matrix.next_contribution: Carry access, attribution and blocker state into every proposed reuse. Use verified original records before broad topic associations.
matrix.evidence_boundary: Indexed does not mean read, attributable, licensed or evidence-rated. A failed fetch does not refute a source.

matrix.title: Versioned ACTC, METAD, UMASC and CUT definitions
matrix.verified_state: Public component references already include source-plus-clarification bundles.
matrix.next_contribution: Reuse the exact bundles and limited role descriptions; retain definitions, disanalogies and relationship direction.
matrix.evidence_boundary: A source-level framework is not exhausted by its OMNI role. Conceptual coherence is not causal or empirical support.

matrix.title: Full-record transfer and loss reporting
matrix.verified_state: Earlier PILOT-A/B/C paired records have reduced PRISM projections; native Thinking Space import remains untested. PR367 already has a coverage companion.
matrix.next_contribution: Specify round-trip invariants for sources, corrections, disagreements, coverage, optional modules and review history before any adapter code.
matrix.evidence_boundary: This was already proposed earlier; it is new engineering work still needed, not a newly discovered module or validated interchange.

matrix.title: Independent usefulness and accessibility evaluation
matrix.verified_state: M08, M11 and other manual acceptance work remain pending; the earlier map already proposed matched-source evaluations.
matrix.next_contribution: Compare the three prepared cases with a simpler review using predefined fidelity, omitted-alternative, comprehension and effort criteria.
matrix.evidence_boundary: No participants, recruitment, independent assessment or superiority result is supplied here.

matrix.title: Model → prediction → measurement → alternatives
matrix.verified_state: Barnes PILOT-B is already prepared with separate version-specific claims in the earlier map.
matrix.next_contribution: Reuse that template and exact source IDs; validate each new theory’s observable and confounders before considering experiments.
matrix.evidence_boundary: The earlier map is inherited context, not a fresh paper appraisal; QDR and Colinear are theoretical proposals, not confirmations.

matrix.title: HOMESENSE/HIERATIC cross-post synthesis
matrix.verified_state: The public specification already defines the method; 809→858 is prepared as PILOT-C.
matrix.next_contribution: Expand only a bounded post selection, recording distinct contribution, disagreement and optional practice prompts.
matrix.evidence_boundary: No whole-series synthesis is claimed; repetition, phase and edition numbers do not strengthen evidence.

matrix.title: Discovery records, corrections and publication dates
matrix.verified_state: Consciousness Library integration and seven-work expansion are on main. Existing BQ source IDs and a title erratum are preserved.
matrix.next_contribution: Reuse discovery overlays; keep news date, online date, issue date, corrections and upstream work identity separate.
matrix.evidence_boundary: AI summaries are discovery aids. Empty correction fields are not evidence of no correction. No bulk export or copying rights inferred.

matrix.title: Information-access research controls
matrix.verified_state: PR405 already contains a protocol, materials and synthetic analysis checks, building on PSI governance.
matrix.next_contribution: Reuse prospective targets, leakage controls, blinded scoring, nulls and source-identity separation. Follow its pending review process.
matrix.evidence_boundary: No experiment, recruitment, extraordinary access or historical-person identity is established. Do not create a second protocol.

matrix.title: STARGATE source and assessment provenance
matrix.verified_state: PR406 already stages six document records plus two reviewer contributions. PR361 is a bounded Reddit census.
matrix.next_contribution: Reuse archival IDs, distinct reviewer attributions and shared-source warnings; verify the census record’s outbound source before linking it to specific reports.
matrix.evidence_boundary: Eight entries are not eight independent experiments. CIA custody and declassification do not validate remote viewing.

matrix.title: Observation and synchronicity journal
matrix.verified_state: SKER is on main; PRISM already adds states, interpretations, outliers and revision history.
matrix.next_contribution: Design a compact private-first entry view against existing fields; preserve the first account and later explanations separately.
matrix.evidence_boundary: No new journal schema is needed. Experiences do not authenticate psychic ability or external sources.

matrix.title: Cultural and creative reference atlas
matrix.verified_state: Existing encounter and PRISM fields already preserve context, authority, interpretation and restrictions.
matrix.next_contribution: Reuse attributed concepts and licensed asset metadata. Treat cultural motifs and visual analogies as distinct relationships.
matrix.evidence_boundary: Shared motifs do not establish common ontology, physical mechanisms or authority to represent a tradition.

matrix.title: Care-action feasibility record
matrix.verified_state: HOMESENSE858 is a published design proposal; the earlier PILOT-C is an optional action record.
matrix.next_contribution: Connect the existing prototype to REL-001/002, then cost and co-design a limited offer before any commitment.
matrix.evidence_boundary: No operating commons, secured funding, benefit guarantee or participant data. Essential support remains independent of credits.

matrix.title: Portable research bundle standards
matrix.verified_state: Earlier map already proposed PROV, SKOS and RO-Crate crosswalks; existing packets preserve source and revision records.
matrix.next_contribution: Choose one versioned public-metadata package and evaluate a lossless mapping only after core source identity work.
matrix.evidence_boundary: No standard conformance or adapter tested here; formal mappings must preserve uncertainty and per-file rights.

matrix.title: Permission-filtered retrieval
matrix.verified_state: PR400 is a separate draft with public-retrieval boundaries and unresolved production/review requirements.
matrix.next_contribution: Reuse its work after its own gates pass; avoid presenting source discovery as a deployed, permission-cleared retrieval service.
matrix.evidence_boundary: No deployed authorization, actual source permission or production readiness verified by this matrix.

matrix.title: QMM–PP or physical-dimension bridge
matrix.verified_state: The public component record and CUT clarification explicitly leave this bridge unestablished.
matrix.next_contribution: Keep separately attributed hypotheses and optional philosophical modules; require a precise, discriminating claim before empirical linkage.
matrix.evidence_boundary: No automatic same-entity, mechanism, memory-survival or dimensional-access edge.

matrix.title: Historical-person or 7D information mechanism
matrix.verified_state: Earlier discussion motivated a design question; PR405 deliberately separates hidden-target accuracy from source and ontology.
matrix.next_contribution: Retain as a hypothesis with ordinary recall, inference, cueing and leakage alternatives. Use the existing protocol for any permitted accuracy question.
matrix.evidence_boundary: Brain geometry, semantic resemblance or accurate content cannot identify a historical person or higher-dimensional information store.

new_module_finding: No genuinely new core module is established by this review. The strongest additions are three missing crosswalks. A loss-reporting adapter would be new implementation of an already recorded proposal.

method.name: AkashicOMNI
method.scope: Manual comparison using all twelve public role descriptions; not execution of complete constituent frameworks or PR367 packet conformance

perspective_coverage.reason: Distinguish inspected records from appealing associations and catalogue presence.
Retain symbolic meaning, cultural attribution and limits in application mappings.
Ground care proposals in needs, practical constraints and embodied experience.
Use reversible candidate records and explicit reject/revise conditions.
Separate repair and ecological outcomes from intention or transaction counts.
Allow unfamiliar hypotheses while preventing an experience-to-cause inference.
Expose schema mismatches, causal levels, assumptions and duplicate implementations.
Review conceptual compatibility without claiming empirical validation of ACTC.
Preserve old versions, corrections and original Jigsaw IDs.
Pin repository heads and separate public manual status from draft engineering.
Specify tests, dependencies, rejection conditions and proportionate next work.
Keep personal, interpersonal, institutional and ecological claims at their stated levels.

method.synthesis: Reuse existing source and review machinery; nominate three precise, reversible crosswalks. Defer interfaces, experiments and broader merges until separate acceptance and source review.
disagreements_and_tensions: A meaningful conceptual connection may add burden without improving decisions.
Public manual availability does not release the engineering pilot.
Useful care practices and their spiritual explanations require separate evaluation.

generator_parameters.selection: Three explicit crosswalks after bounded duplicate screen
generator_parameters.policy: All inferred, unaccepted, no evidence or rights transfer

public_metadata_disposition.reviewer: Codex AI; no independent human sign-off claimed

limitations: Bounded review of current main and six selected draft trees; 35 open PR metadata records inspected. No exhaustive history, every branch, chat, social account, private message or archive survey.
The existing integration map was read and reused. Its three cases remain draft companions; earlier structural checks were not rerun and native Thinking Space transfer was not tested.
N2N record 1w92g5v failed direct retrieval in this pass; its repository audit remains inherited evidence of review scope only and is not an endpoint in the three candidate edges.
Other N2N audit entries are inherited checkpoints, not fresh whole-source reviews. Broader catalogue provenance blockers remain unresolved.
The three relationships are AI-inferred design candidates; no human adjudication, scientific effectiveness, software interoperability or source-rights clearance is certified.
Duplicate screen uses endpoint co-occurrence queries plus manual reading; absence is scoped, not a universal novelty claim.
